product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides AI voice, chat and employee assistants that automate customer service and banking transactions for credit unions and community banks.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link in the public navigation/footer; the pricing URL did not expose a pricing page, and purchasing is demo-led.

employee_band.notes: Company-profile headcount is 193; this is a profile estimate, not an audited employee total.

eng_blog.notes: The index is aimed at banking leaders and contains marketing, product and industry insights; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored product-build posts was established.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help link was found in the navigation or footer; docs.interface.ai and help.interface.ai did not expose readable documentation. Product pages and webinars are not a documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed platform/product material, blog references, security information, privacy policy and Trust Center subprocessors. Public statements refer to foundation models and proprietary AI but do not establish a named production model or model provider; cloud-hosting providers alone do not establish one.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type 2, and lists GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced October 22, 2024; $20 million Series A equity plus $10 million debt, totaling $30 million. These were concurrent financing components.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly documented financing is October 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; no later round was found.

launched_6mo.notes: A July 27, 2026 company post says “Introducing Nexus” and offers a first look at its Five Pillars, meeting the requested introducing-post criterion within May 9–November 9, 2026. Nexus was originally unveiled April 14, 2026; the July post is not evidence of its original launch date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bryan Dooley’s dated employment profile lists SVP, Customer Experience at interface.ai from May 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. This is self-reported profile evidence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Technical Support Engineer – L2 responsibilities explicitly require resolving tickets and maintaining audit-ready case documentation in Salesforce Service Cloud.
